highlights_headline: The next SkiaSharp release delivers compiler-generated XML documentation alongside managed packages.
highlights_body: API documentation is now authored with C# XML comments, while the bundled renderer incorporates the latest m154 upstream fixes.

bullets.detail: The bundled Skia engine incorporates the latest Chrome m154 upstream corrections.
Compiler-generated XML documentation is packaged with managed assemblies so IDE help and API documentation stay aligned with the shipped surface.
